segments.speaker: PRESENTER
segments.en: Good evening.

segments.speaker: PRESENTER
segments.en: Tonight s show comes to you from the Good Home Exhibition in Duke’s Court, where we’ve been trying out some of the latest gadgets on show here and getting our resident expert - Liz Shearer - to tell us which ones are worth buying and which will die a death.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Well, hello.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Yes, John, I’ve been investigating four new household gadgets and sorting out the advantages and disadvantages and then really deciding what are ‘Must buys’, what are ‘Maybe buys’ and what are ‘Never buys’.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Let’s start with this vacuum flask for keeping drinks hot.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Well...

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: I felt this had quite a lot going for it, most of all is the fact that it contains no glass O11 and is therefore unbreakable to all intents and purposes.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: It’s made of stainless steel which is guaranteed for 20 years .. . hope that’s long enough . .. and it’s true what the manufacturer claims - that it does maintain heat for 18 hours.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: So that’s pretty good.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: On the down side, it really works out to be quite expensive and, much more surprisingly, it unfortunately leaves a strange taste . . . you know when you’ve drunk from it... so all in all, my recommendation would be it’s got plenty of advantages, but it is rather expensive so I’d say you should maybe buy it.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Moving on to a natty little device .. . the Whistle Key Holder.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Basically this is where you whistle and the key holder gives off a high pitched noise and flashes light so you can find it.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: One advantage of this model is that it also has a small light.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: You press the button and this means you can find keyholes easily.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: I also felt the small size was a real advantage.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: On the weaker side, I did find the noise unpleasant.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Which I m sure the designers could have done something about.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: And I found that it didn’t work through metal, so it’s mainly useful for finding in coat pockets, cushions, etc.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: But taken as a whole I thought it was a masterpiece of design and would highly recommend it. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ The third gizmo is called the Army Flashlight because it was developed initially for military use.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: It works by squeezing the handle to generate the 019 power.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: Its advantages are that it can be used for outside activities, and also ... and this is one of the surprising features... it does work underwater.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: My main objection to it though was although it did work in these conditions, this model gave off a weak light.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: So my recommendation I’m afraid would have to be to avoid this one.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: The decoy camera was last on my list.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: This is a fake video camera which you fix to your wall to scare off burglars.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: The advantage of this model is something which makes it look very realistic ... its flashing light.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: On the down side, it was quite difficult to fix to the wall.

segments.speaker: LIZ SHEARER
segments.en: However, burglary is such a major problem these days that it is worth the effort, so this gets my strong recommendation.

segments.speaker: PRESENTER
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: PRESENTER
segments.en: Thanks for that, Liz.
